title: Which face tracking and avatar software for a new VTuber?
body: Starting as a VTuber means choosing between a flat Live2D-style avatar and a three-dimensional one, and then a tracking program. What setup are you using, and what limits did you hit with a webcam versus a phone?

The [VSeeFace site](https://www.vseeface.icu) describes a free face and hand tracking program for VRM and VSFAvatar avatars. The [VTube Studio homepage](https://denchisoft.com) describes an app for bringing Live2D models to life, and the [Warudo homepage](https://warudo.app) describes 3D VTubing software with built-in face and hand tracking.
Tell us your avatar type, your camera and what you would change if you started again, including costs of commissioning a rig.
